name: Tumblr
tagline: Social blogging platform API for posts, blogs, likes, and reblogs
description: Tumblr API provides programmatic access to blogs, posts, likes, follows, and user data on the Tumblr social blogging platform. Supports OAuth 1.0a/2.0 authentication for reading and writing content, discovering blogs, and interacting with the Tumblr ecosystem.

auth.details: OAuth 1.0a and OAuth 2.0; consumer key/secret from app registration at tumblr.com/oauth/apps

use_cases: fetch blog info and post counts
list recent posts from a Tumblr blog
create or reblog a post to a blog
get authenticated user likes and following
